articles.title_original: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
articles.title_zh: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
facts_zh:
Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
- Published
Israeli strikes in Gaza have killed at least eight people, including a child, according to hospitals, despite a year-old ceasefire.
In Gaza City to the north, hospital officials said a missile attack hit a group of civilians next to Cairo School in the Al-Rimal neighbourhood, killing three people, including a child.

In the southern city of Khan Younis, the Hamas-run ministry of interior said a drone attack targeted a group of police officers in the Al-Mawasi area, killing five, as they were carrying out their routine duties.

all_titles.en: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say

articles.title_original: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
articles.title_zh: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
facts_zh:
Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
- Published
Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, says it has covered 90% of the $6.3bn (£4.7bn) assets stolen in a hack on Thursday.
The remaining 10% may take longer to source in the required amounts, the company added.
Binance has consistently pledged to cover 100% of the losses from what is suspected to be crypto's biggest hack on record and said it has set aside more than $6.34bn in company funds to do so.

all_titles.en: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack

articles.title_original: The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading
articles.title_zh: The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading
facts_zh: A truce has cooled the trade conflict, but neither country has done anything to limit the outbreak of new hostilities Donald Trump ’s trade wars have largely fallen off the headlines.

Fears of new tariffs flare up from time to time when the US president goes off the rails – for instance, threatening to end US trade with countries with which it has a deficit unless the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates.

But the sense that the world’s two largest economies are plowing ahead into an overt economic conflagration has taken a back seat to other, more salient fears, about Trump ending American democracy, AI killing us all and stuff like that.

all_titles.en: The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading

articles.title_original: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
articles.title_zh: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
facts_zh:
India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
- Published
Tens of thousands gathered in Delhi for a rally demanding the resignation of India's chief election commissioner over a controversial revision of voter lists.

Organised by the opposition INDIA bloc and led by Rahul Gandhi's Congress party, the protest drew many of the alliance's most prominent leaders in a show of strength against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.
Protesters waved flags and chanted "Save the vote, save the country" and "Vote thief, give up power".

all_titles.en: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
